const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Interactive RoboWits limited-mode episode controller.
+
+Run this once to retain a single Robot client. It accepts one JSON command per
+stdin line; see help() below. Sensor snapshots and executed chunks are recorded
+under /app/output/record/.
+"""
+import json
+import pathlib
+import sys
+import time
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/output/record")
+OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+r = Robot()
+spec = r.spec()
+(OUT / "spec.json").write_text(json.dumps(spec, indent=2))
+counter = 0
+
+
+def snapshot(depth=False, seconds=0.0):
+    global counter
+    if seconds:
+        o = r.get_obs(seconds=seconds, video="both", depth="last" if depth else None)
+    else:
+        o = r.get_obs(depth=depth, video="none")
+    d = OUT / f"obs_{counter:03d}"
+    d.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+    for cam, arr in o.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(np.ascontiguousarray(arr)).save(d / f"{cam}.png")
+    for cam, arr in o.last_depth.items():
+        np.save(d / f"{cam}_depth.npy", arr)
+    for cam, b in o.video.items():
+        (d / f"{cam}.mp4").write_bytes(b)
+    (d / "meta.json").write_text(json.dumps(o.meta, indent=2))
+    counter += 1
+    return o, str(d)
+
+
+def execute(cmd):
+    op = cmd.get("op")
+    if op == "help":
+        return {"commands": [
+            "{op:'obs', depth:true}", "{op:'watch', seconds:2, depth:true}",
+            "{op:'submit', type:'ee_pose'|'joint_position', actions:[[...]], dt:0.1, video:'mp4'}",
+            "{op:'fk', q:[14 arm joints]}", "{op:'ik', targets:{frame:[x,y,z,qw,qx,qy,qz]}, seed:[14]}",
+            "{op:'status'}", "{op:'quit'}"]}
+    if op == "spec":
+        return spec
+    if op == "status":
+        return r.status()
+    if op == "fk":
+        return r.fk(cmd["q"], links=cmd.get("links"))
+    if op == "ik":
+        return r.ik(cmd["targets"], seed=cmd.get("seed"), **cmd.get("opts", {}))
+    if op in ("obs", "watch"):
+        o, folder = snapshot(bool(cmd.get("depth", False)), float(cmd.get("seconds", 0)) if op == "watch" else 0)
+        return {"saved": folder, "time_left_s": o.meta.get("time_left_s"),
+                "done": o.meta.get("done"), "reason": o.meta.get("reason"),
+                "now": o.meta.get("proprio", {}).get("now")}
+    if op == "submit":
+        global counter
+        kwargs = {"video": cmd.get("video", "mp4"),
+                  "depth": cmd.get("depth", "none"),
+                  "note": cmd.get("note", "")}
+        if "dt" in cmd:
+            kwargs["dt"] = float(cmd["dt"])
+        res = r.submit(cmd["type"], np.asarray(cmd["actions"], dtype=np.float32), **kwargs)
+        folder = OUT / f"chunk_{counter:03d}"
+        res.save(str(folder))
+        counter += 1
+        (folder / "meta.json").write_text(json.dumps(res.meta, indent=2))
+        return {"saved": str(folder), "time_left_s": res.meta.get("time_left_s"),
+                "done": res.meta.get("done"), "reason": res.meta.get("reason"),
+                "plan": res.meta.get("plan"), "clipped": res.meta.get("clipped"),
+                "control_steps_chunk": res.meta.get("control_steps_chunk"),
+                "proprio_last": res.proprio[-1].tolist() if res.proprio is not None and len(res.proprio) else None}
+    if op == "quit":
+        raise EOFError
+    raise ValueError(f"unknown op: {op}")
+
+
+print(json.dumps({"ready": True, "base": r.base, "time_left_s": r.get_obs(video="none").meta.get("time_left_s")}), flush=True)
+for line in sys.stdin:
+    try:
+        answer = execute(json.loads(line))
+        print(json.dumps(answer, default=lambda x: np.asarray(x).tolist()), flush=True)
+    except EOFError:
+        break
+    except Exception as e:
+        print(json.dumps({"error": type(e).__name__, "message": str(e)}), flush=True)
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
